sentences.en: We need to figure out if it's gossip or gospel.
sentences.zh: 我们需要弄清楚这是流言还是真相。

sentences.en: Afterward, I found out that the Gospel contains too many inconsistencies.
sentences.zh: 后来我发现《福音书》中有太多矛盾之处。

sentences.en: Each of the four Gospels describes the life of Jesus Christ.
sentences.zh: 四部《福音书》中的每一部都描述了耶稣基督的一生。

senses.zh: 传播福音的；福音赞美诗的
